parameters.solver: Frozen E074/E075:delay3,a,b1..28,c0..28,top16 unigram families, all24389 prefixes exact per retained family. No omissions or hidden resets.
parameters.selection: Highest mean fourgram score among55 inputs; stable page order for ties. Freeze all55 output hashes and winner before nulls.
parameters.null: 19 independent selected-page interior shuffles preserving endpoints,counts,doublets; cap100000 proposals. Entire screen and exhaustive retained-family prefix search repeated.
parameters.inference: Plus-one p=(1+exceedances)/20, Bonferroni55. Minimum corrected p is1; coarse screening, no significance claim. Zero exceedances triggers separately preregistered larger calibration.
parameters.limits: Only16 of22736 coefficient/constant families retained. Exactness applies only to their prefix space. English-prose model, no interrupted updates. No community solution claims.
